privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
privacy.subtitle: Protection of telecommunications, subscriber, and network infrastructure data under applicable privacy laws.
privacy.sec1Title: 1. Data Collected from Subscribers and Network
privacy.sec1Desc: To deliver ISP services and manage NOC operations, we process:
privacy.sec1Item1Body: Full name, legal identification (CC/NIT), mobile/WhatsApp number, and email address.
privacy.sec1Item2Body: Installation address, GPS coordinates, PPPoE username, assigned IP, ONU/Router MAC, and optical power (Rx dBm).
privacy.sec1Item3Body: Digital payment receipts (#RC-XXXX), transaction history, and service cut-off/activation states.
privacy.sec2Desc: Data is used strictly for technical operations and network maintenance:
privacy.sec2Item1: Provisioning and session synchronization on MikroTik RouterOS enrouters.
privacy.sec2Item2: Automated delivery of digital payment receipts and billing reminders via WhatsApp.
privacy.sec2Item3: Preventive diagnostics of optical signal levels and traffic telemetry.
privacy.sec2Item4: Automated AI agent assistance to verify delinquency and link status.
privacy.sec3Desc: Each brand operates under logical data isolation. Passwords are encrypted with bcrypt, MikroTik router connections use encrypted API (optional TLS), and web traffic is secured with modern SSL/TLS certificates.
privacy.sec4Desc: Inquiries handled by the WhatsApp AI Agent generate anonymized triage logs for auditing and response quality, without sharing personal data with public models.
privacy.sec5Desc: Subscribers may request to access, update, rectify, and delete their personal data in accordance with telecom regulations and Habeas Data principles.
privacy.contactDesc: For privacy inquiries or to exercise your rights, contact your ISP administration or email privacy@kontroldev.com.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Service
terms.subtitle: Operational policies, MikroTik infrastructure management, and Kontrol ISP NOC software.
terms.sec1Desc: Kontrol ISP is a comprehensive management platform for Internet Service Providers (ISP & WISP) centralizing MikroTik RouterOS nodes, subscriber contracts, and AI-powered helpdesk.
terms.sec2Desc: The network operator (Brand/Tenant) is responsible for providing valid credentials and access ports (RouterOS API 8728 / 8729 TLS) for telemetry and automated commands:
terms.sec2Item1: Kontrol ISP does not interfere with physical routing nor assume liability for operator backhaul link outages.
terms.sec2Item2: Router credentials and database records are securely stored in an isolated multi-tenant architecture.
terms.sec2Item3: The operator must ensure appropriate firewall rules and access lists for the Kontrol ISP server IP.
terms.sec3Desc: The billing and collections module executes automated cut-off and reconnection rules:
terms.sec3Item1: Each subscriber may have 1 to N contracts bound to specific nodes and internet plans.
terms.sec3Item2: In case of delinquency exceeding the grace period, the system may automatically suspend PPPoE credentials or assign delinquent profiles.
terms.sec3Item3: Upon registering a valid payment, the system immediately reactivates service on the corresponding router node.
terms.sec4Desc: The AI agent provides Tier-1 support through a 3-phase protocol (subscriber/delinquency identification, optical telemetry & cable verification, human escalation). AI assistance is advisory and does not replace on-site technical visits for physical link failures.
terms.sec5Desc: Administrators and technicians must safeguard access credentials, refrain from reverse engineering proprietary protocols, and comply with telecom regulations in their jurisdiction.
terms.contactDesc: For contractual inquiries, support escalations, or adding new router nodes, contact your brand NOC or the central Kontrol ISP team.
